   receipt=self.directory/name
   fd=finish(lambda:os.open(receipt,os.O_RDWR|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|getattr(os,'O_BINARY',0),0o600));held=os.fstat(fd)
   try:

     try:

      os.lseek(fd,0,os.SEEK_SET);offset=0
      while offset<len(raw):
       count=os.write(fd,raw[offset:]);assert count>0;offset+=count

      while part:=os.read(fd,65536):readback+=part;assert len(readback)<=1024**2

     except BaseException as error:fault(error)
    ref={'file':str(receipt),'sha256':digest(raw)}
   finally:finish(lambda:os.close(fd))
   return ref
  ref=persist_record(phase+'.original-closed.json',row)

  if fault_total>row['observationFaultTotal']:
   negative={'format':'sabalan-original-receipt-finalization-negative/v1','phase':phase,'originalPid':child.pid,'primaryClosure':ref,'actualChildClosed':True,'primaryReceiptDescriptorClosed':True,'observationFaults':faults,'observationFaultCounts':fault_counts,'productionAdmission':False}
   self.children.append(persist_record(phase+'.receipt-finalization-negative.json',negative))

 def execute_complete_flow(self,binding,backup_password):
  validate_bound_inputs(binding)
  # Every helper is a fixed sibling; no caller module or application key value
  # can be supplied as an authority override. Final source binds these hashes.
  helpers={}
  for name in ['memory_appkeys','backup_credential','appkey_delivery','backup_material','terminal_cleanup']:
   file=pathlib.Path(__file__).with_name(name+'.py');assert file_sha(file)==binding['helperPins'][name+'.py']
   spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('fixed_'+name,file);module=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(module);helpers[name]=module
  secret=bytearray(secrets.token_urlsafe(48).encode('ascii'))
  recipient=helpers['memory_appkeys'].MemoryRecipient();application_keys=None
  try:
   # Source-owned fresh cohort is established before secret/key/backup work.
   initial=None
   for phase in ['initialComposeGuard','stageInitial','archiveComposeGuard','stageArchive','unpackComposeGuard','stageUnpack']:
    staged=self.run_original(binding['phaseCommands'][phase],phase)
    if phase.endswith('ComposeGuard'):helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_compose_guard(staged,binding)
    if phase=='stageInitial':
     initial=json.loads(pathlib.Path(staged['stdout']['file']).read_bytes());helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_initial(initial,binding)
   assert initial is not None
   command,output,spec_sha,remote_sha=helpers['appkey_delivery'].materialize(self,binding,recipient.public_pem)
   delivery=self.run_original(command,'appkeyDelivery',maximum_stdout=65536)
   envelope=helpers['appkey_delivery'].delivered(json.loads(pathlib.Path(delivery['stdout']['file']).read_bytes()),output,spec_sha,remote_sha)
   application_keys=recipient.open(envelope,binding['applicationKeyBinding'])
   operation=binding['applicationKeyBinding']['operation'];backup_plan=helpers['backup_material'].build(operation)
   with helpers['backup_credential'].private_backup_password(self,backup_password)as password_file:
    material=self.run_original(helpers['backup_credential'].plink_argv(password_file,backup_plan['prepareRemoteCommand']),'backupPrepare',backup_plan['materialFrame'],redact_password=backup_password.encode('utf8'))
    prepared_value=json.loads(pathlib.Path(material['stdout']['file']).read_bytes());transfer_file=helpers['backup_material'].prepared(prepared_value,backup_plan,operation)
    first=self.run_original(helpers['backup_credential'].plink_argv(password_file,backup_plan['resealRemoteCommand']),'backupReseal',bytes(secret),redact_password=backup_password.encode('utf8'))
    transfer=json.loads(pathlib.Path(first['stdout']['file']).read_bytes());assert transfer['format']=='sabalan-independent-complete-transfer-content/v1'and transfer['privateRsaExported']is False and transfer['transferPassphraseStored']is False
    assert transfer['operation']==operation and transfer['cipherFile']==transfer_file and transfer['sourceCipherSha256']==backup_plan['sourceCipherSha256']and transfer['sourceCipherBytes']==backup_plan['sourceCipherBytes']
    assert transfer['fullGcmAuthenticated']is True and transfer['plaintextIdentityProvenance']=='ORIGINAL_AUTHENTICATED_DECRYPT'and transfer['publishedPlaintextDigestClaimed']is False
    download='exec cat -- '+shlex.quote(transfer_file)
    second=self.run_original(helpers['backup_credential'].plink_argv(password_file,download),'cipherDownload',maximum_stdout=transfer['cipherBytes'],redact_password=backup_password.encode('utf8'))
    assert second['stdoutBytes']==transfer['cipherBytes']and second['stdout']['sha256']==transfer['cipherSha256']
    for phase in ['stageCipherComposeGuard','stageCipher','verifyCipherComposeGuard']:
     row=self.run_original(binding['phaseCommands'][phase],phase)
     if phase.endswith('ComposeGuard'):
      text=pathlib.Path(row['stdout']['file']).read_text()
      try:rows=json.loads(text);rows=rows if isinstance(rows,list)else[rows]
      except ValueError:rows=[json.loads(line)for line in text.splitlines()if line.strip()]
      assert len(rows)==10 and {r['Service']:r['ID']for r in rows}==binding['localComposeIds']and all(r['Project']=='sabalanerp-local'and r['State']=='running'and r['Health']=='healthy'for r in rows)
    verified=self.run_original(helpers['terminal_cleanup'].cipher_command(binding,transfer),'verifyCipher')
    helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_cipher(verified,binding,transfer)
    current_guard=self.run_original(binding['phaseCommands']['localStrictComposeGuard'],'localStrictComposeGuard');helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_compose_guard(current_guard,binding)
    body=json.dumps({'passphrase':secret.decode('ascii'),'applicationKeys':application_keys},separators=(',',':')).encode()
    third=self.run_original(binding['phaseCommands']['localStrictRestore'],'localStrictRestore',body)
    value=json.loads(pathlib.Path(third['stdout']['file']).read_bytes());assert value['strictCompleteValidationSucceeded']is True and value['databaseAbsent']is True and value['productionAdmission']is False
    assert not self.interrupted
    qualification,pins=helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validated_qualification(value,binding,self.directory)
    # Failed FULL never enters retirement; all incident evidence stays held.
    local_command=helpers['terminal_cleanup'].local_command(binding,pins,initial)
    guard=self.run_original(binding['phaseCommands']['localCleanupComposeGuard'],'localCleanupComposeGuard')
    helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_compose_guard(guard,binding)
    local_retired=self.run_original(local_command,'localCleanup')
    helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_local_retired(local_retired,operation)
    backup_command=helpers['backup_material'].cleanup_command(operation,prepared_value,transfer)
    backup_retired=self.run_original(helpers['backup_credential'].plink_argv(password_file,backup_command),'backupCleanup',redact_password=backup_password.encode('utf8'))
    helpers['terminal_cleanup'].validate_backup_retired(backup_retired,operation)
    assert not self.interrupted
   # SAME credential file finally retired after all plink/Docker originals.
   windows_retired=helpers['terminal_cleanup'].retire_windows_inputs(binding,second,transfer,self.directory);save(self.directory/'windows-inputs-retired.json',windows_retired)
   return {'format':'sabalan-owned-complete-transfer-strict-restore/v1','children':list(self.children),'strictCompleteValidationSucceeded':True,'protectedFinancialQualification':qualification,'temporaryTransferRetired':True,'localJobRetired':True,'outerOriginalClosurePending':True,'productionAdmission':False}
  finally:
   recipient.close()
   if application_keys is not None:application_keys.clear()
   for i in range(len(secret)):secret[i]=0

def read_master_private_credential(operation):
 import re
 assert re.fullmatch(r'[a-f0-9]{32}',operation)
 print(json.dumps({'format':'sabalan-r9-master-private-credential-ready/v1','operation':operation,'credentialsRead':False,'productionAdmission':False}),flush=True)
 raw=bytearray(sys.stdin.buffer.readline(16385))
 try:
  assert 0<len(raw)<=16384 and raw.endswith(b'\n')
  assert sys.stdin.buffer.read(1)==b''
  frame=json.loads(raw)
  assert isinstance(frame,dict) and set(frame)=={'format','operation','credential'}
  assert frame['format']=='sabalan-r9-master-private-credential/v1' and frame['operation']==operation
  credential=frame['credential']
  assert isinstance(credential,str) and 0<len(credential.encode('utf-8'))<=4096 and '\x00'not in credential
  frame.clear()
  return credential
 finally:
  for i in range(len(raw)):raw[i]=0
